name: glycemic goals of care in adults with diabetes pathway
title: Setting a glycated hemoglobin (A1c) target by risk of hypoglycemia: 6.5% or less for selected type 2 diabetes, 7.0% or less for most, 7.1 to 8.5% for the frail, with what drives the tight and the relaxed targets

nodes.title: Drivers:
lines: young, long life expectancy, short duration, no structural complications yet, not on a drug that causes hypoglycemia

nodes.title: Drivers:
lines: recurrent severe hypoglycemia or unawareness, dementia, seizure disorder, frailty, falls, functional dependence, life expectancy under ~2 years
